privacy.summary.title: In short
privacy.summary.body: You can use Zalumo without an account; you only need one to post reviews. We don’t sell or share your personal data, and there are no ads, no analytics and no tracking.
privacy.device.title: What stays on your phone
privacy.device.body: Your saved stays, search filters, language and appearance choices, and the reviews you reported or blocked are stored only on your device. Deleting the app deletes them.
privacy.content.title: Photos and maps
privacy.content.body: To show photos and maps, the app downloads them from content servers (photo hosting and map providers). Like any website, these servers receive your device’s IP address and basic technical details needed to deliver the files. We send them nothing else about you.
privacy.apps.title: Calls, directions and websites
privacy.apps.body: When you tap Call, Directions, Website or Email, the app opens your phone’s dialer, maps app, browser or mail app. What happens next is covered by those apps’ own privacy policies.
privacy.reports.title: Reports and messages
privacy.reports.body: When you’re signed in, reports go straight to our moderation queue, linked to your account. Otherwise, or when you contact us, your mail app sends us an email with your email address and the details you choose to include. We use it only to handle your report or reply to you, review reports within 24 hours, and delete the message once it’s no longer needed.
privacy.listings.title: About the listings
privacy.listings.body: Names, addresses, phone numbers, ratings and collected reviews of places come from publicly available business information. Collected reviews are shown without reviewer names; reviews written in the app show the name their author chose. If you run a listed place or wrote a review and want something corrected or removed, contact us.
privacy.children.title: Children
privacy.children.body: The app is meant for a general audience and doesn’t knowingly collect information from children.
privacy.changes.title: Changes
privacy.changes.body: If this policy changes, we’ll update it here and change the date at the top.
privacy.contact.title: Contact
privacy.contact.body: Questions about privacy or a request to remove information:
guidelines.intro: Reviews help travellers choose where to stay. To keep them useful and respectful:
guidelines.1: Write about your own stay, honestly.
guidelines.2: Be polite: no insults, hate or threats.
guidelines.3: Don’t share phone numbers, emails, links or anyone’s personal details.
guidelines.4: No advertising, fake reviews or paid reviews.
guidelines.5: One review per place; you can edit it any time.
guidelines.enforcement: Reported reviews are checked and may be removed. Accounts that break these rules can be blocked.
privacy.account.title: Your account and reviews
privacy.account.body: If you sign in with Apple or Google to post reviews, we receive your name and email address from them. Your reviews, ratings and the name you choose are public in the app; your email is never shown. Your account and reviews are stored with our hosting provider (Supabase). Reports and blocks you make are linked to your account so we can moderate. You can change your name, delete a review, or delete your account and all your reviews at any time in Settings or by emailing us.
